item.tib: chos kyi dbyings su bstod pa
item.coloph: chos kyi dbyings su bstod pa/ slob dpon klu grub kyis mdzad pa rdzogs s+ho// rgya gar gyi mkhan po kri sna ban di ta dang/ lo tsa ba dge slong tshul khrims rgyal bas bsgyur cing zhus te gtan la phab pa

item.tib: chos kyi dbyings su bstod pa
item.coloph: chos kyi dbyings su bstod pa slob dpon klu grub kyis mdzad pa rdzogs s+ho// rgya gar gyi mkhan po krisna paN+Di ta dang/ lo ts+tsha ba dge slong thsul khrims rgyal pas bsgyur cing zhus te gtan la phab pa
